_: Planted red/green controls linked by GROUP marker to the spawned tests that drive the guard's exit code.

expectRed: blocks a production edit after a review round until plan-critic is dispatched
arms the branch when a gate-round agent is dispatched
arms the branch when a conditional agent is dispatched
arms the branch again when the next round dispatches a reviewer
blocks a production target reached through an exempt directory via ..
blocks a production file whose path contains apps/web/e2e/ below another directory
blocks a production file inside a .claude/worktrees/ checkout when the gate is armed
still blocks on a corrupt gate state file
mutations.note: Forces the block helper to exit 0 instead of 2 — the reason is printed but the edit is no longer blocked.

expectRed: allows any edit when no gate state exists
mutations.note: Removes the early no-state-file return — the hook falls through to loadState, whose read of the missing file throws and blocks.

expectRed: arms the branch when a gate-round agent is dispatched
arms the branch when a conditional agent is dispatched
arms the branch again when the next round dispatches a reviewer
keeps the other branches entries when a dispatch arms the current branch
mutations.note: A gate-round or conditional dispatch writes an unlocked entry — the round never arms the branch.

expectRed: unlocks the branch when plan-critic is dispatched after a round
mutations.note: A plan-critic dispatch leaves the branch armed.

expectRed: allows a production edit when the armed entry belongs to another branch
mutations.note: The edit check reads the first entry of any branch instead of the current branch's.

expectRed: unlocks the branch when plan-critic is dispatched after a round
allows a production edit when the branch is unlocked
mutations.note: The edit check no longer honours unlocked: true.

expectRed: allows a production file outside the repo root when the gate is armed
mutations.note: A path outside the repo root (a scratch clone) is checked like a production file.

expectRed: allows a spec.ts edit under apps/web/e2e/ even when the gate is armed
mutations.note: Removes the apps/web/e2e/ allowance — a spec edit under apps/web/e2e/ is blocked again while the gate is armed, even though e2e-writer/red-team need to write there.

expectRed: blocks a production target reached through an exempt directory via ..
mutations.note: Removes path normalization — the raw path still starts with the apps/web/e2e/ directory, so the exemption lets a production target through.

expectRed: blocks a production file whose path contains apps/web/e2e/ below another directory
blocks a production file inside a .claude/worktrees/ checkout when the gate is armed
mutations.note: Matches an exempt directory anywhere in the path instead of under its checkout root — <root>/vendor/apps/web/e2e/x.ts, and any worktree file under .claude/, is let through.

expectRed: blocks a production file inside a .claude/worktrees/ checkout when the gate is armed
mutations.note: Drops the worktree carve-out — a production file inside .claude/worktrees/ passes as an exempt .claude path.

expectRed: allows a docs edit inside a .claude/worktrees/ checkout when the gate is armed
mutations.note: Denies every exemption inside a worktree — the worktree's own docs/, .claude/ and apps/web/e2e/ files are blocked.

expectRed: unlocks after plan-critic when the state file was unreadable
mutations.note: A plan-critic dispatch no longer repairs an unreadable state file — the throw escapes, nothing is saved and the edit stays blocked.

expectRed: blocks an armed production edit when the session cwd is a subdirectory
mutations.note: The gate state is read from the session cwd — an edit after a Bash cd into a subdirectory finds no state and passes.
